description: The finite Boolean truth-table satisfiability test returns true exactly when some valuation satisfies every premise.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.checkSatisfiable_eq_true.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.checkSatisfiable Γ = true ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Satisfiable Γ
